DC Board of Elections results XML exports.

Discovery: https://electionresults.dcboe.org/electionResults/getElectionResultsId
Info: https://electionresults.dcboe.org/electionResults/getElectionInfo/2024-General-Election
XML: https://electionresults.dcboe.org/Downloads/Reports/November_5_2024_General_Election_Certified_Results.xml
Fetched: 2026-10-27
Trimmed to a subset of federal, citywide, legislative and local contests plus turnout totals.

2026 general (election-night unofficial)
Info: https://electionresults.dcboe.org/electionResults/getElectionInfo/2026-General-Election
XML: https://electionresults.dcboe.org/Downloads/Reports/November_3_2026_General_Election_Election_Night_Unofficial_Results.xml
Fetched: 2026-11-04 (UTC; election night 2026-11-03)
Trimmed to the turnout totals plus the delegate, mayor, at-large council and shadow-senator
contests; each kept ContestDataExportViewModel is verbatim. 144 of 144 precincts counted,
457,371 registered voters and 155,969 ballots cast.
